function.description: Get trial details for field notices detection on network devices
function.name: api_getTrialDetailsForFieldNoticesDetectionOnNetworkDevices

response.description: Details of the security advisories trial

active.description: Indicates if the trial is active

contractLevel.description: Contract level for which trial was created. this was used in older versions and exists only for compatibility.

endTime.description: Trial end time; as measured in Unix epoch time in milliseconds

feature.description: Name of the feature for which trial was created. for older versions that created contract type trials, this field will be absent.

secondsRemainingToExpiry.description: Seconds remaining in the trial before it expires. for expired trials this will be 0.

secondsSinceExpired.description: Seconds elapsed after the trial has expired. for active trials this will be 0.

startTime.description: Trial start time; as measured in Unix epoch time in milliseconds

type.description: Type of trial: * 'feature - the trial is of type feature. this is the currently supported type. * 'contract' - the trial is of type contract. this was used in older versions and exists only for compatibility.
